text:
maya: Quick sprint notes — ran shortbench across L4/T4/A10G for embeddings and small-chat in us-east, eu-west, apac-sin. Posting highlights + ask on kernel choices.

anil: nice. got numbers?

maya: pasted a quick csv: 
```
region,gpu,workload,median_p95_latency_ms,throughput_rps,est_cost_usd_per_1M_tokens
us-east,A10G,embeddings,12,980,8.5
us-east,T4,embeddings,25,420,5.2
us-east,L4,embeddings,9,1100,9.8
us-east,A10G,small-chat,28,320,12.0
us-east,T4,small-chat,70,120,7.0
us-east,L4,small-chat,22,380,13.5
eu-west,A10G,embeddings,16,720,9.1
apac-sin,A10G,small-chat,34,280,13.8
```

frank: interesting: L4 wins latency on both workloads but cost per token higher; T4 is cheapest per token for embeddings but struggles on small-chat tail.

sophie: @maya how did you config quant? q4_0 for L4 and T4? which kernel?

maya: yes q4_0 for T4/L4, q8_0 for A10G when possible. runtime: fused-attn-v2 on L4/A10G, kf32 fallback on T4. batch sizes: emb b64, chat b8.

kai: can you paste configs? want to reproduce.

maya: sure:
```
# run command
./bench --model ./weights/l4-q4_0 --quant q4_0 --gpu L4 --batch_size 8 --seq 512 --workload chat
```

bench-bot: Scheduled run 2839501270: kf32->fused-attn-v2 diff applied.

anil: does p95 include first-token generation? what about streaming vs sync?

maya: sync end-to-end, includes prefix KV warmups. first token included. streaming reduced apparent latency by ~8-12% on chat.

frank: region delta: APAC adds ~8-12ms base RTT — affects tail. for capacity sizing, use throughput_rps * target_util(0.7) -> nodes needed.

sophie: quick calc: for us-east small-chat target 100k qps (requests per hour?) wait thats wrong. compute per-minute. we should size for 95th percentile concurrency. proposal in comments.

maya: proposed rollout: canary on A10G eu-west for chat (lower cost than L4 per throughput?), monitor quality. :eyes: 

kai: +1. Also recommend switching T4 kernels to int8 path in next run to squeeze cost.

maya: thanks — I'll queue follow-up runs (int8 path + streaming). dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/bench/emb-chat/283950

sophie: added notes to eval prompt set about slight degradation on instruction-following with q4_0 on chat.

anil: nice thread. keep us posted.
